title: Pilk has another warning

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Are you sub-letting your apartment to a migrant family of carpet weavers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sub-letting your apartment to a migrant family of carpet weavers?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: It must be the other one then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It must be the other one then.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Well, just so you know, you are not allowed to sub-let.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, just so you know, you are not allowed to sub-let.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Also, if you have a friend over, and they stay, and they give you money, or a gift, or even a compliment, that is considered sub-letting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Also, if you have a friend over, and they stay, and they give you money, or a gift, or even a compliment, that is considered sub-letting.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Certainly! You are an adult - you can figure this out for yourself. For example, you have a toilet. Why not hide - I mean reside - in there until your guest leaves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Certainly! You are an adult - you can figure this out for yourself. For example, you have a toilet. Why not hide - I mean reside - in there until your guest leaves.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: The other extremely low income tenant in one of my "Economy Minus" properties.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The other extremely low income tenant in one of my "Economy Minus" properties.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Yes. If a visitor gives you anything at all, and they stay more than thirty minutes, that's considered sub-letting. To be safe, consider having no guests. And if you do have guests, it's best to avoid them completely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. If a visitor gives you anything at all, and they stay more than thirty minutes, that's considered sub-letting. To be safe, consider having no guests. And if you do have guests, it's best to avoid them completely.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Very good. Enjoy your day. And remember, no parties!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. Enjoy your day. And remember, no parties!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How would that even be possible on 20 square meters?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How would that even be possible on 20 square meters?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How would that even be possible on 20 square meters?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How would that even be possible on 20 square meters?
